verdict.rationale: Each skill ships as a SKILL.md folder with frontmatter; a runtime probe confirmed `name: tdd` reads back cleanly after a real install. The same set is documented to work with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, through the cross-agent `npx skills` installer and per-vendor plugin marketplaces, so the skill folders are clearly portable beyond one vendor. missing for 10: explicit statement of conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, hands-on verification on a non-Claude agent (the probe only installed for claude-code).
